author: iFixit
description:
When a tiny battery wears out, why should the whole pair of earbuds go?
We open the Fairphone Fairbuds 2 to see how replaceable batteries challenge disposable tech—and where repair could still improve.
The Fairbuds 2 are smaller than their predecessors, but their earbud batteries still slide out without tools. Inside, we explore how Fairphone fits ANC, microphones, sensors, and accessible batteries into a compact design, then open the charging case to check its battery and USB-C port.
Along the way, CT scans reveal hidden components, we explain why glue isn’t always the enemy of repair, and we put the earbuds back together in working order. The result: a 10/10 repairability score, with one improvement we’d like to see.
What ended the life of your last pair of wireless earbuds—and could a replaceable battery have saved them?
